scope: CRM Consulting: B2B research and review-only outreach drafts, Shymkent
basis: Owner clarification plus descriptive read-only analysis of 61 successful qualification-pipeline deals over the preceding 365 days.

rules.rule: Ethical primary-business filter precedes commercial qualification.
CRM identity and relationship history precede offers; read-only allowlist only.
Need, specific-offer fit and contact permissibility are separate; an email is not buying intent.
No cold drafts for C/D; no repeated performed/rejected service without a new evidenced basis and a contact decision.
Internal research is not displayed to recipients; one product, concrete benefit, one CTA; no unsupported loss/problem claims.
No sending, calling, CRM writing, external history transfer or automatic ECC hooks.
Retain publication/event date, last actual verification, source availability and vacancy status separately.
Warm introductions require an evidenced relationship and introducer permission, not inferred common interests.

Treat an external course, adviser, peer recommendation, industry event, or business community as an awareness trigger only when the prospect or a permitted public source explicitly confirms it; never infer it from title, industry, or generic training activity.
A fresh evidenced implementation event may produce more substantive dialogues than generic contact availability.
rules.validation: Compare prospect cohorts with fixed inclusion criteria; record actual replies and meetings, not predicted conversion.

rules.rule: Permission to send one useful workflow scheme may lower first-contact friction.
rules.validation: Record recipient reactions and negative responses across comparable companies; one positive reply is insufficient.

rules.rule: Accounting/1C and B2B marketing firms may support consent-based mutual referrals.
rules.validation: Record actual partner agreement, permitted introduction, meeting and purchase; no warm path assumed.

rules.rule: An explicitly stated external learning or influence trigger may indicate an already-formed CRM implementation intent: for example, a course, business adviser, peer recommendation, industry event, or business community explained that CRM could support sales or process control.
rules.lead_hunter_action: Capture the exact stated trigger and its source as evidence; use it to tailor discovery questions and offer framing, not as an automatic score increase or permission to contact.
rules.validation: Across comparable qualified opportunities, record trigger, stated need, meeting held, proposal sent and purchase outcome; include counterexamples and missing data.

rules.rule: For an evidenced CRM implementation need, a combined hypothesis around process setup, communication channels, and adoption may fit more often than a licence-only framing.
rules.evidence: Among 40 successful qualification deals with product rows, the most frequent explicit bundle was CRM setup/structure + communications/telephony + training/adoption (9 deals).
rules.validation: Compare complete, permission-safe offer hypotheses against licence-only framing in a predefined cohort; do not claim causal lift before measured outcomes.

rules.rule: A prompt documented first response is a repeated characteristic of successful qualification deals.
rules.evidence: 54 of 61 successful qualification deals had a first recorded action within one day; 58 within three days.
rules.lead_hunter_action: Flag missing first action for manager review by the next business day; do not treat this descriptive pattern as proof of causal conversion lift.
rules.validation: Compare timed, comparable new opportunities with complete outcome capture and a non-winning cohort.

promotion_requires: Predefined population, outcome and comparison basis
Owner approval and new immutable version
